steps.content: It's only when you reach the bottom of the TV station and look up at it that you realize it stands there like the Tower of Babel, its top out of sight.
Despite the bright white lights, you feel as if you are facing an abyss.
Your already glum mood suddenly becomes overwhelming. You understand this feeling too well. Like being called back to work just before bed, with no means to vent your grievances.
"Hello, welcome to this building."
"Pleased to meet you in this place, at this moment."

As you open the doors of the building, you are immediately plunged into darkness. Then a dazzling light suddenly lights up, blinding you. A pleasant female voice rings in your ears, forcing you to squint and look up...
The walls of the gloomy interior are lined with countless LCD screens of various sizes.
Perched on the walls, they peer at you like prisoners.
And in those eyes, you see many duplicates of... Eleven.

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: Whatever you need, just name it.

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: I will provide you with a service beyond your imagination.
On the big TV screen, Eleven is greeting and briefing you with a smile. Her voice is sweet, her smile bright, and her outfit impeccable. But it makes your scalp tingle.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your voice... Is this "Call at 3 AM"?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But why Eleven?! Why is she here?

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: Didn't you ask me to be here?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I asked you to be here...?!
You remember that poem and that you told Eleven there might be clues at the TV station. Could this unsettling scene be your own request?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What we're looking for is the key to get out of here!

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: Whether you want to leave or stay...

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: I, we... will always be with you.

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: Wherever you are, you can call me.

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: My eyes serve you.

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: My hands serve you.

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: My voice serves you.

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: I, we, will always serve you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What... what does this all mean??

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: We, are the perfect products.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Perfect products?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You are people... or maybe not...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But calling yourself a product never sounds like a good idea.

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: Don't you remember? Don't you think so?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course I don't think so!
Hold on... Suddenly, you realize that her question isn't directed at you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eleven! Don't listen to her, it's not like that...!
You turn around wanting to grab Eleven, but you find her staring intently at those versions of herself, unmoving.
Her lips move slightly and a faint voice oozes out of her throat. Bit by bit, phrase by phrase, it's becoming clear...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Yes... You're right... I am the Call at 3 AM... I am the host of the program.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I... I've always remembered... I remember now... From when I first started working, until now, how I speak, why I speak...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Wherever you are... you can... call me.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: My eyes... serve you...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: My hands... serve you...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: My voice... serves you...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Everything that makes me... will be at your service... Your needs are above all...
The cold white light from the screen is cast on her face, revealing a horrifying green hue. The light in her eyes fades away again.
You're taken aback. The girl you know is a greenhorn who left campus not long ago. How did that innocent girl suddenly become...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You... You're the person behind "Call at 3 AM"? No, this must be...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What have you done?! Are you controlling her?!
The person on the screen smiles, lifting the corners of her mouth without showing her teeth.

steps.speaker: Eleven on TV
steps.content: Control her? Haha~ Can one control oneself? I've always been her... And she's always been me... She may just have forgotten it, along with her voice.
Eleven's voice merges with the voice from the screen. Getting a premonition, you instinctively turn around only to see Eleven fading right in front of you!
She melts and floats away like the silhouette of a sound wave, entering the endless screens. All the Elevens are smiling down at you.
Her eyes, her mouth, her hands, and her heart. They're all watching you.
You look around and find that the entrance you came in through has disappeared, blending into the dark walls. All you can do now is to cross these screens and enter this unknown building.

steps.speaker: Intercom
steps.content: Zzt, zzt...
On the check-in counter next to you, a black walkie-talkie flashes a few times, apparently receiving an incoming message.
You shoot it a glance. Suppressing your anger, you walk to the counter and pick up the walkie-talkie.
You press the button on its side. After a few crackles of radio signal, you hear a familiar voice.

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Congratulations! You've helped Eleven... to find her own voice~

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, the truth of this world has not been revealed. That's not her voice... Or rather, it's not the voice she wants, am I right?

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Hehe... How can that be? This is her dream...
You slam the walkie-talkie on the counter. The signal pauses for a moment, then comes back sharper with a cacophony of noise.

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: She wants to be better, to be perfect, just like the person in her dreams...

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: But that's a product, the perfect product in the boss's eyes...

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Thank you for making her... the perfect product!
